import tomlkit


def test_issue_543():
    doc = tomlkit.loads("a.b = 1\n")
    doc["a"]["c"] = {}
    doc["z"] = 2

    # The bug causes 'z = 2' to be nested under '[a.c]'
    # The expected behavior is for 'z = 2' to remain a top-level key.
    expected_dump = """a.b = 1
z = 2

[a.c]
"""
    assert tomlkit.dumps(doc) == expected_dump
